svg.title: VHTR 100–150 MW(th) — Annotated Engineering Cutaway
svg.desc: Vertical section through a helium-cooled, graphite-moderated very high temperature reactor installed in a below-grade pre-cast concrete cavity, with direct Brayton turbomachine, recuperator, air-cooled precooler and passive air-cooled reactor cavity cooling system.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

g.text: HELIUM-COOLED · GRAPHITE-MODERATED · TRISO-FUELLED · DIRECT BRAYTON — LONGITUDINAL SECTION A–A
A 20-metre cube. Twelve metres of it sit below grade, and that depth is not spare
volume — it is the chimney that makes the cooling passive. Helium at 4 MPa leaves the
core at 950 °C, turns the turbine directly, and comes back through a recuperator to
that same core: no intermediate heat exchanger, no secondary loop, no cooling water,
and not one valve, fan or pump anywhere in either air circuit.
~12–14 m into rock or firm soil
one visit a year; 6–10 fuel batches
LOW-LEAKAGE CONFINEMENT ENCLOSURE — NOT PRESSURE-RATED (FUNCTIONAL CONTAINMENT, SECY-18-0096)
RCCS RISER — NO FANS, NO VALVES
20 m TOTAL ENVELOPE = RCCS EFFECTIVE CHIMNEY HEIGHT
Shield plug over the vessel head;
the closure — not shipped to site.
the cavity perimeter. Cannot be shut.
in situ. Cavity built in 2–3 weeks.
Takes 6.5 MW decay heat at t = 0.

and no pool cooling to fail.

DETAIL A — WHY THE CHANNELS ARE NOT DRILLED
A gyroid partitions the block into two interpenetrating domains — helium and graphite. It cannot be
machined, only additively built, and it is what recovers the pressure-drop penalty of running at 4 MPa.
five layers, drawn to relative scale
DETAIL B — THE FIRST THREE BARRIERS
Kernel, coatings and graphite matrix retain > 99.99 % of fission products. The SiC layer is the real
pressure vessel of this reactor; the steel one only contains the coolant. 80–100 GWd/tHM discharge.
No intermediate heat exchanger. No secondary loop. No water.
air heated by the vessel, rising
Section drawn at a true 1:1 aspect ratio, vertical = horizontal.
Details A and B are magnified and are not to section scale.
Numbered callouts 1–20; cycle state points shown as diamonds 1–6.
GENERAL ARRANGEMENT · SECTION A–A · DIMENSIONS IN METRES UNLESS NOTED · NO WATER SUPPLY REQUIRED AT ANY POINT IN THE PLANT

FOAK VARIANT — 850 °C core outlet with a nickel superalloy turbine: ~43 % cycle, ~43–65 MW(e), peak fuel ~1,140 °C, 460 °C margin. The nuclear island is identical; only the turbomachine and recuperator alloy change.
